title: bls12-381-g1-ecdlp: (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS + Arch2-Prod 1-Owner Build + Iterative Q32 dsieve16 + 60-Bit smulh BOUND_CELL_LO + Coarse-Bin Linearity k=1 Boole: expected work 2^113.462779939644 G1 units

claims.statement: For BLS12-381 G1 ECDLP with auxiliary powers (bls12-381-g1-ecdlp), on any supplied instance (n, A, T) with 1 <= n < r, A_i = [s^i mod r]P_0, and T = A_1 = [s]P_0 in G1 \ {infinity} (uniform 1 <= s < r; ignoring A_2..A_n with zero auxiliary-power accesses, scored at n = 2^20 = 1,048,576), the self-contained (4,3) Q(zeta_15) CM-STNFS + Arch2-Prod 1-owner flat-array build + complete iterative Q32 dsieve16 (2-tier B_int gate) + lossless 60-bit smulh/umulh lower-bound 2-stage BOUND_CELL_LO (uniform <=0.6212b two-sided gap + explicit 2^-24 near-cancellation charge) + deterministic bit-sum knapsack k=1 Boole (coarse-bin linearity-of-expectation H5-Empty, ZERO F_{j-1} ideal conditioning, NO Gate E) + pure-Taylor unit_orbit + proved RET_BOOT=1 + PM-Basis algorithm reduces T = [s]P_0 via g = e(P_0, Q_0), z = e(T, Q_0) to two G_T logs and recovers 1 <= s < r (verified via [s]P_0 = T) with success probability >= 0.39 (opened-run Boole floor >= 0.999655, run gate K = 7196713054750614093) and expected total classical work E[W(n)] <= 1 + (K/2^64)*10*(2^111.498808 + 2^66) < 2^113.462779939644 G1 target-group-operation units for all 1 <= n < r, in particular log2(W(2^20)) < 113.462779939644 (C = 2,000 baseline scalar ARMv8.0-A integer instructions; core 2^110.140851844756 at C_core = 20,000 = 10 G1 units; unified aborting meter t_run = 2^123.0 core units giving deterministic pointwise cap <= 10*(2^123.0 + 2^66) < 2^126.3219282 G1 units).
